name: Palisade Bio, Inc.
summary: PALISADE BIO INC is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapeutics for acute and chronic gastrointestinal (GI) complications. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, their lead product candidate, PALI-210, is an oral formulation designed to protect and repair the intestinal barrier. The company aims to improve outcomes for patients suffering from GI disorders.
